output.explanation: Expanded modular-core by pulling its terminal and font branches downward into two detailed peripheral diagrams. The central diagram retains application coordination, Surface-owned execution and policy boundaries; the peripherals distinguish public types from owned instances and private implementation details. session-io and session-rendering remain unchanged because they are already focused. Checked the pinned checkout's exports, ownership, synchronization and dependencies. Clarifications include fresh caller-owned vtStream parser state, Ghostty-only search.Thread, public screen/font types despite nested ownership, and SharedGrid locking limitations. Preserved all existing edges, retargeting moved concepts, and connected font shaping directly to terminal snapshots.

Ghostty's surface-centered core
|  Nesting shows module contents or explicitly owned instances; -> means uses.
|
|-- App - application-wide coordination (src/App.zig)
|   |-- Public: create/destroy, tick, addSurface/deleteSurface, updateConfig
|   |-- Registry: runtime-surface pointers, focus and application actions
|   |-- Mailbox: public queue contract; tick drains requests on the app thread
|   |-- Owned shared instances: font.SharedGridSet and optional renderer.Device
|   |-- -> apprt actions; Surface config dispatch; input application bindings
|   `-- Source: src/App.zig:22-198,563-613
|
|-- apprt - native UI boundary, not a Surface implementation detail
|   |-- Public: runtime App/Surface, Action/Target, clipboard types, surface.Mailbox
|   |-- Compile-time adapters: executable GTK/none, library embedded, WASM browser
|   |-- Runtime owns window/tab/split interpretation; core receives surface events
|   `-- Source: src/apprt.zig:1-53; src/Surface.zig:1-16
|
|-- Surface - one interactive terminal session (src/Surface.zig)
|   |-- Public: init/deinit/close, draw, handleMessage, updateConfig
|   |   |-- key/text/mouseButton/scroll/preedit callbacks; size/focus callbacks
|   |   `-- completeClipboardRequest, performBindingAction; Mailbox/Message aliases
|   |-- Event policy and retained state
|   |   |-- Keyboard (public type): sequences and key-table stack
|   |   |-- Private Mouse/Search types; pressed-key state and optional Inspector
|   |   |-- Private maybeHandleBinding precedes private encodeKey
|   |   `-- Selection, links, clipboard permissions and search orchestration
|   |-- Owned execution instances
|   |   |-- Process/IO: termio.Termio + termio.Thread + OS thread [expanded]
|   |   |   `-- -> renderer.State mutex, renderer wakeup and mailbox
|   |   |-- Rendering: Renderer + renderer.Thread + OS thread [expanded]
|   |   |   `-- -> IO-owned Terminal through shared State; app font grid/device
|   |   `-- Shared State: terminal pointer, allocated mutex, preedit and mouse data
|   |-- Lifecycle: stop search, join render/IO workers, then release shared state
|   |-- Policy: owned DerivedConfig, conditional state and shared-font grid key
|   |-- -> apprt callbacks/actions; input codecs; terminal selection/text/search
|   |-- -> Config-derived settings; font.SharedGridSet.ref/deref
|   `-- Source: src/Surface.zig:69-153,210-303,477-765,829-875,2987,3326
|
|-- terminal - reusable semantics and state [expanded]
|   |-- Public Terminal, Stream/Parser and read interfaces
|   |-- Termio owns Terminal; renderer owns its RenderState snapshot
|   `-- Semantic model is independent of Surface, PTY and graphics backends
|
|-- font - shared resources and text shaping [expanded]
|   |-- Public SharedGridSet/SharedGrid; Shaper/ShaperCache
|   |-- App owns the set; Surface holds a grid key, renderer uses the grid

termio - Surface-owned execution, module exported by src/termio.zig
|
|-- Public Termio: init/deinit, processOutput, queueMessage, resize, getProcessInfo
|   |-- Owns Terminal, Backend, DerivedConfig and persistent StreamHandler.Stream
|   |-- Borrows renderer.State and renderer/surface mailboxes
|   `-- processOutput: acquire State.mutex, parse bytes, schedule repaint
|       `-- Private processOutputLocked: inspector tracing or bulk nextSlice
|
|-- Backend - public tagged union; only exec is implemented at this commit
|   `-- Exec - PTY/command transport
|       |-- Private Subprocess: command, PTY and shell-integration lifecycle
|       |-- Public ReadThread: platform-specific read pipeline
|       |   |-- POSIX io-gather: read/poll into bounded rotating buffers
|       |   |-- POSIX io-reader: consume batches -> Termio.processOutput
|       |   |   `-- yieldToDemand between batches lets renderer acquire the lock
|       |   `-- Windows: serial blocking read/process loop, no gather stage
|       `-- threadExit stops subprocess and joins the reader pipeline
|
|-- Public Thread + Message/Mailbox - asynchronous write/control plane
|   |-- threadMain runs the writer event loop; backend performs PTY writes
|   |-- Private timers: coalesced resize, selection scroll, sync-output timeout
|   `-- Surface writes and VT replies enter the same control path
|
|-- Public StreamHandler - application-aware VT adapter
|   |-- Stream = terminal.Stream(StreamHandler); state survives across reads
|   |-- Retains APC/DCS handlers, clipboard transactions/grants, optional tmux viewer
|   |-- -> terminal edits/protocol types; termio mailbox for replies/control
|   `-- -> Surface mailbox for title, clipboard and resize requests
|
|-- -> Rendering: shared State mutex, repaint wakeup and renderer mailbox
|-- -> Surface: child-status messages; -> Config: derived settings/Exec options
`-- Source: src/termio.zig:20-33; termio/Termio.zig:29-74,705-763,857;
    src/termio/backend.zig:13-25; Exec.zig:86-165,196-229,587,1269-1524;
    src/termio/Thread.zig:1-96; stream_handler.zig:19-108

renderer - Surface-owned display, module exported by src/renderer.zig
|
|-- Public Renderer = GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI)
|   |-- Public: updateFrame/drawFrame, setFontGrid, setScreenSize, changeConfig
|   |-- Snapshot phase in updateFrame
|   |   |-- State.lockDemand/unlockDemand encloses RenderState.beginUpdate
|   |   |-- Also updates viewport/image state and captures overlays under the lock
|   |   `-- RenderState.endUpdate runs after unlock, before consuming the snapshot
|   |-- Frame assembly: cell/image buffers, shaping cache, uniforms and swap chain
|   |   `-- draw_mutex protects state shared with drawFrame
|   `-- Presentation: GPU draw, custom shaders and backend-dependent exported frames
|
|-- Public Thread + Message - render scheduling
|   |-- Mailbox and wakeups; immediate draw handle
|   |-- Cursor blink, shader/Kitty animation timers, scrollback compression
|   `-- Borrows Renderer, State and runtime surface; Surface owns worker lifetimes
|
|-- Public State - shared access contract, NOT terminal-state ownership
|   |-- Terminal pointer, mutex pointer, inspector, preedit and mouse overlay data
|   |-- lockDemand/unlockDemand/yieldToDemand coordinate fairer access with IO
|   `-- Mutex protects referenced member data, not the State container itself
|
|-- Graphics implementation
|   |-- Private GraphicsAPI selection: Metal or OpenGL at compile time
|   |-- Public Device alias; App owns the optional shared device instance
|   `-- Public Metal/OpenGL and GenericRenderer exports allow backend-specific use
|
|-- -> terminal.RenderState: snapshots, dirty state, selections and image data
|-- -> font: shared grid, shaping, glyph rasterization, metrics and atlases
|-- -> apprt/Surface: presentation and status messages; -> Config: derived policy
`-- Source: src/renderer.zig:15-45; renderer/State.zig:13-104;
    src/renderer/Thread.zig:1-87; generic.zig:90-155,1317,1371-1567,1716,2171,2249

terminal - reusable semantic model (src/terminal/main.zig)
|  Nested state branches show owned instances; types are also public exports.
|
|-- Public Terminal - mutation API and retained state
|   |-- init/deinit, print/printSlice, resize, vtStream/vtHandler
|   |-- Modes, colors, dimensions, tabstops, title/pwd and cursor policy
|   `-- Owned ScreenSet: active key/pointer, screen map and generations
|       |-- Public get/getInit/switchTo; alternate screen initialized lazily
|       `-- Owned Screens: cursor, tracked selection, charset and dirty flags
|           |-- Per-screen Kitty keyboard/images and semantic prompt state
|           `-- Owned PageList: viewport, tracked Pins and allocation pools
|               `-- Private Node: resident Page or compressed representation
|                   `-- Page storage: rows/cells, styles and text metadata
|
|-- Public decoding and semantic adapter interfaces
|   |-- Stream(Handler): init/deinit, next/nextSlice; dispatches StreamAction
|   |   |-- Owns handler, Parser, UTF8Decoder and optional continuation tracker
|   |   `-- Parser: incremental VT state and OSC parsing; APC/DCS events to handler
|   |-- TerminalStream = Stream(stream_terminal.Handler)
|   |   |-- Handler borrows Terminal; owns APC/DCS protocol state
|   |   `-- Optional effects callbacks for replies, bells, title and clipboard
|   `-- Terminal.vtStream creates fresh parser state, not a retained Terminal field
|       `-- Caller must reuse/deinit stream; default effects do not emit replies
|
|-- Public read/inspection interfaces - not children of a Terminal instance
|   |-- Selection: Pin-based ranges; Screen.select maintains tracking
|   |-- search: Terminal/Screen/PageList/Viewport/Active search APIs
|   |   `-- Thread: Ghostty-only xev worker; exported as void for library builds
|   |-- formatter: Terminal/Screen/PageList/Page formatters; plain/VT/HTML
|   `-- RenderState: renderer-independent, caller-owned incremental snapshot
|       |-- beginUpdate: requires exclusive Terminal access; copies dirty state
|       |-- endUpdate: completes deferred work using snapshot-owned memory
|       `-- Rows/cells, styles, selection and image placements for consumers
|
|-- -> Used by Termio for mutation, Surface for interaction, renderer for snapshots
|-- Boundary: semantic model needs no Surface, PTY or graphics backend

    ScreenSet.zig:17-110; Screen.zig:37-88; PageList.zig:51-106;

font - shared grid resources and shaping (src/font/main.zig)
|  Nesting shows module contents or explicitly owned instances, not consumers.
|
|-- Public SharedGridSet - App-owned resource registry
|   |-- ref(DerivedConfig, size) -> Key + grid; deref(Key) releases a reference
|   |-- Owns keyed/ref-counted grid map, Library and optional Discover
|   |-- Private collection(): constructs configured/deferred font collection
|   `-- Map has a mutex; ref is nevertheless documented NOT thread-safe
|
|-- Public SharedGrid - instances owned by the set, shared across surfaces
|   |-- getIndex: cached resolution; loads deferred faces under the grid lock
|   |-- renderGlyph/renderCodepoint: cached rasterization into owned atlases
|   |-- Owns codepoint/glyph caches, grayscale/color Atlas and Metrics
|   |-- Owned CodepointResolver (also a public font type)
|   |   |-- getIndex: style/presentation, overrides, sprite and fallback policy
|   |   |-- Owns Collection and descriptor cache; borrows Discover/codepoint map
|   |   `-- Owned Collection (also public): priority-ordered faces by style
|   |       `-- Loaded Face and DeferredFace entries; deferred loading options
|   |-- RwLock: methods lock caches; direct atlas access requires caller locking
|   `-- cellSize -> renderer.CellSize (not thread-safe); change grid, not its size
|
|-- Public shape module - independent of SharedGrid instance ownership
|   |-- Shaper alias: compile-time HarfBuzz/CoreText/noop/web_canvas selection
|   |-- RunOptions -> terminal.RenderState.Cell rows and a borrowed SharedGrid
|   |-- RunIterator/TextRun: single-row runs, font index and position-independent hash
|   |   `-- -> SharedGrid resolution; selection/cursor boundaries split runs
|   |-- Shaper produces glyph-index cells and offsets, not GPU draw calls
|   `-- Cache (ShaperCache alias): get/put; owns copies of shaped cells by run hash
|
|-- Other public building blocks: Face, DeferredFace, Atlas, Metrics, sprite
|-- -> Config font policy; renderer owns its shaper/cache and uses shared atlases
|-- -> terminal snapshots supply shaping input; terminal does not depend on font
`-- Source: src/font/main.zig:7-31; SharedGridSet.zig:35-105,156-178,413;
    SharedGrid.zig:41-65,143-197,379; CodepointResolver.zig:33-63,124;
    Collection.zig:1-15,35-83; shape.zig:8-36,42-85;
    shaper/run.zig:10-52,89-100; shaper/Cache.zig:20-77
